claims.claim: Russia hit three bridges in Kyiv overnight in a nationwide assault days after Ukraine damaged the Crimean Bridge.
claims.episode_span: Russia hit three bridges in Kyiv overnight
claims.source_title: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack
claims.supporting_quote: Russia targeted bridges in Kyiv and railway stations overnight in a major attack launched days after Ukraine badly damaged the strategically important Crimean Bridge.

claims.claim: President Zelensky said the strikes were one of the most massive of the war and left at least eight dead, while the BBC reported five people killed.
claims.episode_span: said it left at least eight dead; the BBC reported five people killed
claims.source_title: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack
claims.supporting_quote: Five people were killed in a wave of strikes which follow Ukraine's successful targeting of the Crimean Bridge.

claims.claim: Ukraine's air force said Russia launched almost 100 missiles and around 400 drones.
claims.episode_span: Russia launched almost 100 missiles and around 400 drones
claims.source_title: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack
claims.supporting_quote: Ukraine's air force says almost 100 missiles were launched by Russia in its overnight attack - one of the largest attacks since the invasion began in 2022. It also involved around 400 drones.

claims.claim: The Podilsko-Voskresensky, Darnytskyi and Southern bridges were closed, and Mayor Klitschko said seven medical personnel were injured.
claims.episode_span: The Podilsko-Voskresensky, Darnytskyi and Southern bridges were closed
claims.source_title: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack
claims.supporting_quote: The three Kyiv bridges targeted in Kyiv overnight - the Podilsko-Voskresensky Bridge, the Darnytskyi Bridge and the Southern Bridge - have been closed to traffic

claims.claim: Prime Minister Serhiy Koretsky said 28 people were injured and the assault hit nine regions, including an ambulance hospital in Kharkiv.
claims.episode_span: 28 people were injured across nine regions
claims.source_title: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack
claims.supporting_quote: Prime Minister Serhiy Koretsky said 28 people were injured, with an ambulance hospital in Kharkiv among the targets of an attack which hit nine regions.

claims.claim: Lviv Mayor Andriy Sadovyi said two people were killed at Sknyliv railway station and ten were injured.
claims.episode_span: two people were killed at the Sknyliv railway station and ten were injured
claims.source_title: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack
claims.supporting_quote: Two people were killed in a hit on the Sknyliv railway station in the south-west of Lviv, the city's Mayor Andriy Sadovyi said.

claims.claim: Poland's defence minister said a Russian cruise missile landed about 50 kilometres from the Ukrainian border and no one was harmed.
claims.episode_span: a Russian cruise missile landed about 50 kilometres
claims.source_title: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack
claims.supporting_quote: A Russian cruise missile landed in Poland around 50km (31 miles) from its border with Ukraine, the Polish Defence Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz said on Friday.

claims.claim: Putin said retaliation for the Crimean Bridge strike would be far more painful.
claims.episode_span: retaliation for the Crimean Bridge strike would be far more painful
claims.source_title: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack
claims.supporting_quote: Russian President Vladimir Putin - who personally opened the bridge in 2019 to international condemnation - said the Kremlin's retaliation for the strike would be "far more painful".

claims.claim: The US, China and Russia agreed a symbolic peace declaration and reaffirmed that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought.
claims.episode_span: agreed a symbolic peace declaration
claims.source_title: Trump, Xi and Putin release ‘peace declaration’ from unprecedented summit
claims.supporting_quote: China, the United States and Russia agreed on a symbolic “peace declaration” at an unprecedented three-way summit on Thursday and reaffirmed that nuclear war should never be fought, but announced no plans for arms control talks long sought by Trump.

claims.claim: The declaration did not mention the Ukraine war or the US conflict with Iran, and Putin said nobody would be forced to comply.
claims.episode_span: nobody would be forced to comply with it
claims.source_title: Trump, Xi and Putin release ‘peace declaration’ from unprecedented summit
claims.supporting_quote: The declaration did not mention Russia’s war in Ukraine or the U.S. conflict with Iran, and in a press conference afterwards, Putin acknowledged it did not set ambitious goals and added that nobody would be forced to comply with its decisions.

claims.claim: Trump told NBC the meeting was a 12 on a scale of zero to 10 and told Reuters it was bigger than Yalta.
claims.episode_span: rated a 12 on a scale of zero to 10
claims.source_title: Trump, Xi and Putin release ‘peace declaration’ from unprecedented summit
claims.supporting_quote: “On a scale of zero to 10, I think it was a 12,” he said.

claims.claim: The expected UK-EU package would allow up to 100,000 young adults from each side to live and work in the other for up to three years.
claims.episode_span: up to 100,000 young adults from each side
claims.source_title: U.K. and EU hold rare summit as Burnham seeks to mend Brexit damage
claims.supporting_quote: The deals are set to include an agreement for up to 100,000 young adults from Britain to live and work in EU countries for up to three years, and the same number of Europeans to come to the U.K.

claims.claim: Burnham said the deals could add 0.5 percent to Britain's economy, and an unnamed EU official said the package depends on a tuition-fee agreement within six months.
claims.episode_span: could add 0.5 percent to Britain's economy
claims.source_title: U.K. and EU hold rare summit as Burnham seeks to mend Brexit damage
claims.supporting_quote: Burnham said Friday the deals could add 0.5% to Britain’s economy – he’d previously set it at 0.4%.

claims.claim: Canada's 2026 budget passed the House of Commons by 162 votes to 151.
claims.episode_span: passed the 2026 federal budget by 162 votes to 151
claims.source_title: Liberals’ 2026 budget passes in House of Commons
claims.supporting_quote: Liberal MPs cheered and applauded as the Speaker announced the motion had passed with a vote of 162 to 151.

claims.claim: Budget 2026 includes a $36-billion productivity mega-deduction.
claims.episode_span: a $36-billion productivity deduction
claims.source_title: Liberals’ 2026 budget passes in House of Commons
claims.supporting_quote: Proposals in Budget 2026 such as the $36-billion productivity mega-deduction are aimed at convincing businesses to invest more in their own machinery and boost worker productivity.

claims.claim: Dominique de Villepin announced a 2027 presidential bid and his team says he has 300 of 500 required mayor signatures.
claims.episode_span: pledges from 300 mayors toward the 500 signatures
claims.source_title: Former French prime minister Dominique de Villepin announces presidential bid
claims.supporting_quote: His team maintains that De Villepin has already secured pledges from 300.

claims.claim: Iraqi government forces were expected to move into Jurf al-Sakhar on Friday under a compromise with Kataib Hezbollah.
claims.episode_span: enter the Kataib Hezbollah stronghold of Jurf al-Sakhar
claims.source_title: Iraqi forces strike compromise with powerful pro-Iran militia
claims.supporting_quote: Under the deal brokered by senior Shi'ite political leaders to avert a confrontation, government forces were expected to move into the group's stronghold of Jurf al-Sakhar on Friday.

claims.claim: A Pakistani minister is visiting India for the first time since the 2025 war, and both sides call the visit strictly multilateral.
claims.episode_span: visiting for the first time since the 2025 war
claims.source_title: Pakistan minister visits India for first time since 2025 war
claims.supporting_quote: Islamabad and New Delhi insist the visit is strictly multilateral, despite hopes it could open a channel for contact.

claims.claim: US lawmakers face a December 11 deadline to extend funding, and Democrats due to take Congress are divided over restricting Iran war funds.
claims.episode_span: using December 11 to restrict Iran-war funds
claims.source_title: Democrats want to force Trump to end the Iran war when they take Congress. Can they?
claims.supporting_quote: Lawmakers face a Dec. 11 deadline to extend funding for most federal agencies and prevent a government shutdown.

claims.claim: A British jury convicted four men of sexually assaulting Joanne Young and rejected a defence based on her husband's assurances of consent.
claims.episode_span: a jury convicted four men of sexually assaulting Joanne Young
claims.source_title: 4 British Men Convicted of Sexually Assaulting Joanne Young
claims.supporting_quote: A jury rejected the men’s defense that they had been relying on assurances from Joanne Young’s husband — who himself has pleaded guilty to rape — that she had consented.

claims.claim: Thailand has opened its market to US pork, raising risks for farmers.
claims.episode_span: opened the door to US pork
claims.source_title: Thailand Opens Door to US Pork, Raising Risks for Farmers
claims.supporting_quote: Thailand Opens Door to US Pork, Raising Risks for Farmers

claims.claim: In a trial of daraxonrasib, cancer became undetectable in one in 12 patients and tumours stopped growing in almost all of 61 patients with advanced pancreatic cancer.
claims.episode_span: left the cancer undetectable in one in 12 of them
claims.source_title: Pill to treat pancreatic cancer hailed as ‘biggest breakthrough in decades’
claims.supporting_quote: In one in 12 of the patients given the drug, daraxonrasib , during a trial, the cancer became undetectable, and the tumours stopped growing in almost all of the 61 patients.

claims.claim: Andy Burnham said the Brexit Britain was given has not worked and that the country lost more than it gained.
claims.episode_span: the Brexit Britain was given has not worked
claims.source_title: U.K. and EU hold rare summit as Burnham seeks to mend Brexit damage
claims.supporting_quote: “The Brexit we were given has not worked. We have lost more than we gained,” he said this week.

claims.claim: Nigel Farage told the BBC the Brexit debate has started again and will become a question of rejoining or staying out.
claims.episode_span: the great Brexit debate has just started again
claims.source_title: U.K. and EU hold rare summit as Burnham seeks to mend Brexit damage
claims.supporting_quote: “I’m afraid that the great Brexit debate has just started again,” Reform U.K. leader Nigel Farage told the BBC.
